title: PSU vs UO: tuition, size, accreditation
summary: Portland State University (PSU) versus Oregon Health & Science University (UO). Also searched as UO vs PSU. Scorecard table is sourced; prose is checked against those facts. UniRepository is not affiliated with either school.

sections.heading: How they differ
paragraphs: Portland State University (PSU) and Oregon Health & Science University (OHSU) are both public institutions located in Portland. PSU has a significantly larger undergraduate enrollment, with 13,182 students compared to OHSU's 836. While PSU's in-state tuition is $11,679, OHSU does not provide a listed in-state tuition figure. These differences highlight the contrast between PSU's broader undergraduate focus and OHSU's specialized programs.

sections.heading: Cost
paragraphs: When comparing the cost of attendance, Portland State University (PSU) and Oregon Health & Science University (OHSU) show distinct differences. PSU's in-state tuition is $11,679, whereas OHSU does not report an in-state tuition figure. For out-of-state students, PSU charges $31,074, with no corresponding data available for OHSU. Regarding student debt, the median debt for PSU completers is $20,500, while OHSU completers have a median debt of $16,625. These figures reflect the varying financial commitments associated with attending each institution.

sections.heading: Learning model and campus
paragraphs: Portland State University (PSU) and Oregon Health & Science University (OHSU) are both located in Portland, Oregon, but they differ notably in their learning models and campus environments. PSU serves a larger undergraduate population with 13,182 students, offering a broad range of academic programs across various disciplines. In contrast, OHSU has a smaller undergraduate enrollment of 836 students, reflecting its focus on health sciences and specialized professional education. This distinction influences the campus atmosphere and the educational experience at each institution, with PSU providing a more traditional university setting and OHSU emphasizing health-related fields.

sections.heading: Accreditation

sections.heading: Pick PSU if
paragraphs: Pick Portland State University (PSU) if you prefer a public institution with a high admission rate of approximately 90.87%, indicating a more accessible entry compared to more selective universities. PSU's in-state tuition is $11,679, making it a cost-effective option for Oregon residents. Additionally, the university has a completion rate of about 52.66% within 150% of the expected time, reflecting the proportion of students who finish their programs in a timely manner. These factors make PSU suitable for students seeking an affordable, public university with relatively open admissions.
